title: Weak Passwords Pass the Strength Check
description:
`is_strong_password(password)` in `validator.py` should return `True` only if the password passes **every** rule in `rules.py` (at least 8 characters, has a digit, has an uppercase letter). Right now passwords that fail some rules are still accepted. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Files**
`rules.py` — individual rule functions (each returns `True`/`False`)
`validator.py` — combines the rules into one pass/fail decision

**Function signature**
`is_strong_password(password: str) -> bool`
